records.jp: ふー、これにて一件落着だね！
records.en_original: Whew! Mission accomplished!
records.en_auxiliary: Whew! Mission accomplished!
records.en: Whew! Mission accomplished!

records.jp: 無事に終わって良かった……。<CR>危ない場面も色々あったけど
records.en_original: I'm glad everything worked out all right. We had a few close calls.
records.en_auxiliary: I'm glad everything worked out all right. We had a few close calls.
records.en: I'm glad everything worked out all right.<CR>We had a few close calls.

records.jp: ……やっぱり、奥まで行くのはやめとこう。<CR>“向こうの世界”は危険すぎる
records.en_original: Yeah... We probably shouldn't go too far into the Faraway. It's just too dangerous.
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah... We probably shouldn't go too far into the Faraway. It's just too dangerous.
records.en: Yeah... We probably shouldn't go too far into the Faraway.<CR>It's just too dangerous.

records.jp: でもさ、愛央が元の世界に帰るための手がかり、<CR>あるとしたらあそこぐらいしかないよ？
records.en_original: But that's where we have to go if we want to find any information on getting you home, right?
records.en_auxiliary: But that's where we have to go if we want to find any information on getting you home, right?
records.en: But if there are any clues about how to get you home,<CR>the Faraway is the only place they could be.

records.jp: 帰るの、諦めちゃうの？
records.en_original: Are you giving up on that?
records.en_auxiliary: Are you giving up on that?
records.en: Are you giving up on that?

records.jp: それは……帰れるなら帰りたい
records.en_original: Well... If I was able to go home, of course I'd want to...
records.en_auxiliary: Well... If I was able to go home, of course I'd want to...
records.en: Well... If I could go home, I'd want to.

records.jp: でも、さすがにみんなを危険に巻き込むわけには<CR>いかないよ
records.en_original: But I can't put all of you in danger just for that.
records.en_auxiliary: But I can't put all of you in danger just for that.
records.en: But I can't drag all of you into danger<CR>just so I can go home.

records.jp: 大丈夫、きっと何とかなるって
records.en_original: Don't worry, everything will work out somehow!
records.en_auxiliary: Don't worry, everything will work out somehow!
records.en: Don't worry, everything will work out somehow!

records.jp: いつの間にか来たんだから、同じようにして<CR>帰れるかもしれないし
records.en_original: I just showed up here all of a sudden, so who's to say I won't get home the same way?
records.en_auxiliary: I just showed up here all of a sudden, so who's to say I won't get home the same way?
records.en: I arrived here without knowing how,<CR>so maybe I could go home the same way.

records.jp: ……わたしは、奥まで調べるべきだと思うのです
records.en_original: ...I think we should go deeper into the Faraway.
records.en_auxiliary: ...I think we should go deeper into the Faraway.
records.en: ...I think we should go deeper into the Faraway.

records.jp: ちょ、こころ？
records.en_original: Wha— Kokoro?
records.en_auxiliary: Wha— Kokoro?
records.en: Wha— Kokoro?

records.jp: そうね。ちゃんと調べたほうが良いと思う
records.en_original: Agreed. We should investigate it as thoroughly as we can.
records.en_auxiliary: Agreed. We should investigate it as thoroughly as we can.
records.en: Agreed. We should investigate it as thoroughly as we can.

records.jp: 伶那さんまで！？<CR>二人とも、危険だってわかってる！？
records.en_original: You too?! You guys realize how dangerous it is, don't you?!
records.en_auxiliary: You too?! You guys realize how dangerous it is, don't you?!
records.en: You too, Rena-san?!<CR>Do you both realize how dangerous it is?!

records.jp: うん。それでも、だよ
records.en_original: Yes. But even so.
records.en_auxiliary: Yes. But even so.
records.en: Yes. But even so.

records.jp: ……それに、“向こうの世界”で流れ込んできた記憶。<CR>あれは、わたしのものだと思うんだ
records.en_original: Also... Those memories we saw in the Faraway? I think they might be mine.
records.en_auxiliary: Also... Those memories we saw in the Faraway? I think they might be mine.
records.en: ...And those memories that flowed into us in the Faraway.<CR>I think they were mine.

records.jp: え！？　本当！？
records.en_original: What?! Seriously?!
records.en_auxiliary: What?! Seriously?!
records.en: What?! Seriously?!

records.jp: うん
records.en_original: Yes.
records.en_auxiliary: Yes.
records.en: Yes.

records.jp: あそこに入ったときから感じてたんだ。<CR>なんだか懐かしいって
records.en_original: Ever since we first went in, I felt it. Like I'd seen it all before.
records.en_auxiliary: Ever since we first went in, I felt it. Like I'd seen it all before.
records.en: I've felt it ever since we first went inside.<CR>Like the place was somehow familiar.

records.jp: だから、もっと奥まで調べれば……。<CR>記憶を取り戻せるかもしれない
records.en_original: So, if we explore all the way... Maybe I'd be able to regain my memory.
records.en_auxiliary: So, if we explore all the way... Maybe I'd be able to regain my memory.
records.en: So, if we explore all the way...<CR>Maybe I'd be able to regain my memory.

records.jp: そうしたら、愛央ちゃんのいた世界のことも、<CR>何かわかるかも
records.en_original: And perhaps we'll learn something about Ao's world as well.
records.en_auxiliary: And perhaps we'll learn something about Ao's world as well.
records.en: Then we might also learn something<CR>about the world you came from, Ao-chan.

records.jp: ……ううん。<CR>わたしが、わたしの記憶を取り戻したいんだ
records.en_original: ...Actually, no. I have to admit that my reasons are selfish.
records.en_auxiliary: ...Actually, no. I have to admit that my reasons are selfish.
records.en: ...No.<CR>I want to recover my own memories.

records.jp: こころ……
records.en_original: Kokoro...
records.en_auxiliary: Kokoro...
records.en: Kokoro...

records.jp: あれが靭さんの記憶だというのなら、<CR>私の記憶もどこかにあるのかも
records.en_original: If those memories are yours, then mine might be somewhere in there too.
records.en_auxiliary: If those memories are yours, then mine might be somewhere in there too.
records.en: If those memories are yours, Utsubo-san,<CR>then mine might be somewhere too.

records.jp: それなら、調べてみる価値はありそうじゃない？
records.en_original: If that's the case, it's certainly worth looking into.
records.en_auxiliary: If that's the case, it's certainly worth looking into.
records.en: If that's the case, it's certainly worth looking into.

records.jp: 伶那さん……
records.en_original: Rena...
records.en_auxiliary: Rena...
records.en: Rena-san...

records.jp: それにさ、みんなで何かするのって、<CR>やっぱり楽しいじゃん！！
records.en_original: It'll be fun as long as we're together!
records.en_auxiliary: It'll be fun as long as we're together!
records.en: Besides, doing things together<CR>is fun, isn't it?!

records.jp: 勇希……
records.en_original: Yuki...
records.en_auxiliary: Yuki...
records.en: Yuki...

records.jp: だからね、愛央ちゃん
records.en_original: So, Ao—
records.en_auxiliary: So, Ao—
records.en: So, Ao-chan—

records.jp: わたしたちと一緒に来てほしいのです！
records.en_original: We'd like you to come with us!
records.en_auxiliary: We'd like you to come with us!
records.en: We'd like you to come with us!

records.jp: うん
records.en_original: Okay.
records.en_auxiliary: Okay.
records.en: Okay.

records.jp: それじゃあ、さっそく明日から冒険だ！
records.en_original: All right! Our adventure shall begin on the morrow!
records.en_auxiliary: All right! Our adventure shall begin on the morrow!
records.en: Then our adventure starts tomorrow!

records.jp: 今日は早く寝ましょ。<CR>きっといろいろ動き回ることになるから
records.en_original: We should get to bed soon. It'll be a big day.
records.en_auxiliary: We should get to bed soon. It'll be a big day.
records.en: We should get to bed soon.<CR>It'll be a big day.

records.jp: うん、おやすみ
records.en_original: Yes, that's right. Goodnight!
records.en_auxiliary: Yes, that's right. Goodnight!
records.en: Yeah. Good night.

records.jp: おやすみー
records.en_original: Goodnight!
records.en_auxiliary: Goodnight!
records.en: Goodnight!

records.jp: こうして、一つの事件を乗り越え
records.en_original: Just like that, we had decided.
records.en_auxiliary: Just like that, we had decided.
records.en: And so, having overcome one incident,

records.jp: 記憶を失くし、帰り道を失くし
records.en_original: Despite our memories missing, and having no way to get home...
records.en_auxiliary: Despite our memories missing, and having no way to get home...
records.en: having lost our memories and our way home,

records.jp: まっさらで迷子の私たちは
records.en_original: The four of us started walking forward again.
records.en_auxiliary: The four of us started walking forward again.
records.en: we, blank slates and lost children,

records.jp: また新しい何かを求めて歩き始める
records.en_original: Seeking something new.
records.en_auxiliary: Seeking something new.
records.en: began walking again in search of something new.

records.jp: それは、記憶を探すため
records.en_original: To find our memories.
records.en_auxiliary: To find our memories.
records.en: To find our memories.

records.jp: それは、帰り道を探すため
records.en_original: To find a way home.
records.en_auxiliary: To find a way home.
records.en: To find a way home.

records.jp: そして
records.en_original: And...
records.en_auxiliary: And...
records.en: And...

records.jp: 特別で大切な何かを探すために―――
records.en_original: To find that special, important something.
records.en_auxiliary: To find that special, important something.
records.en: to search for something special and precious—
